items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Roy was a guy like me, he liked to play

ctx.x: So Roy and I used to go jamming everytime we got off

work. Roy was a guy like me, he liked to play and I always -- so we'd go after work to some of the joints around Baltimore and jam. We jammed all over Baltimore, everynight. We'd get home the next day around 12:00 o'clock half soused and sleep all day and then go to work.

So one night we were playing over to one of -- we had a friend there named BAILEY that owned (unintelligible) two or three places. And we were over there playing this night and Cab Calloway's band was playing at the Hippodome Theater. And I, that night I was standing up in a chair half juiced, playing "Memories of You" on alto. And Cab walks in and slipped and says, "what's this," you know. So he offered me a job with the band, you know. And Roy says -- so when he left, Roy said, "Man, you've got a break to go…
